# Design method provenance

Version-Timestamp: 2026-11-05 18:10:00 UTC

BAMA design and native workflow adaptations derive from Dave Ebbelaar's MIT-licensed [BAMA](https://github.com/daveebbelaar/bama/tree/15356bd8ebff408222ad21395aea09bd74b15310). Preserve [its complete notice](BAMA-LICENSE.txt). REA evidence workflows and the optional companion skill derive from [REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea/tree/160d821ac9a0310afcb8d1fc427862dd6508add5), released as rea-agents 6.8.0. Preserve [its complete notice](REA-LICENSE.txt). Main-branch audit commit 570abe95f2a35b5c580a5ec2fca90c33d4114bdc is a separate snapshot.

The kit adapts instructions to project-owned tokens, supported host tools and explicit verification. No upstream brand artwork, client screenshots or credentials are bundled. The optional BAMA and REA plugins preserve fuller workflows; their own provenance records identify exact source bytes and local changes. Runtime installation and actual project output acceptance are separate from reading these methods.

Cinematic web workflow, taste rules, builder prompts, the review addendum, media preparation and the [web technique recipes](../web-techniques/INDEX.md) adapt the MIT-licensed part of [MotionSites claude-skill](https://github.com/Motionsites-AI/claude-skill/tree/faa30d512e3973e58675c72101a7ef42ed37ae83). Preserve [its complete notice](MOTIONSITES-LICENSE.txt). Its example prompts and media are not MIT and are not included.
